questions.title: 01 Read the event
questions.objective: Identify the outcomes described by E.
questions.prerequisites: Read a finite set; distinguish divisible from not divisible.

questions.title: 02 Complete a worked fraction
questions.objective: Complete the denominator in the worked probability calculation.
questions.prerequisites: Count event outcomes and all possible outcomes; read a fraction.

questions.title: 03 Check the counting rule
questions.objective: Choose the calculation that uses the supplied outcome probabilities.
questions.prerequisites: Add exact fractions; distinguish equal from unequal chances.

questions.title: 04 Explain the complement
questions.objective: Choose the set facts that justify the complement rule.
questions.prerequisites: Read complement, intersection, union and the empty set.

questions.title: 05 Repair a counting error
questions.objective: Find the first incorrect line, then correct the probability.
questions.prerequisites: Read line labels; test set membership; count multiples of three.

questions.title: 06 Try a fresh token problem
questions.objective: Find the exact probability of drawing a token that is not red.
questions.prerequisites: Count individual tokens; combine disjoint colour groups; simplify a fraction.
